description: WSO2 SAP Successfactors Employee Central Core provides a way to interact with the [SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central APIs](https://api.sap.com/package/SuccessFactorsEmployeeCentral/overview). The service provides comprehensive access to core employee central functionalities and global employee information.
key-features: Comprehensive Employee Central APIs for employee data management
Access organizational structure and position information
Query global employee information across multiple regions (e.g. Argentina, Brazil, China, Switzerland, the UK)
